title: Make document conversion recoverable across partial filesystem failures
description:
Audit key: S06
Evidence class: source-risk
Baseline: f6ca003f255fe7636e97d63ba80e4bfcd9cffa32 (2026-09-30 Australia/Sydney)
Sources: internal/projectconvert/convert.go:Run; internal/translate/conversion.go

Evidence:
Run claims atomic conversion but sequentially renames every target, then deletes sources, then saves changed configuration. A later rename/delete/config failure leaves earlier changes in place. Temporary names are predictable target+.tmp.

Scope: Test/fix/optimise existing behaviour only. Record reproduction, changed paths, tests, measurements and commit in notes; maintain CHANGELOG.md. Unproven candidates can be resolved with a documented measurement-based no-change decision.
acceptance_criteria: Inject target write/rename, source deletion and config/state-save failures. Preserve originals and translation state or perform verified rollback; reject target collisions and existing temporary symlinks. Successful Markdown/MPD conversions remain semantically equivalent.
notes:
2026-10-02 confirmed authenticated conversion data loss at e8eac75:3 unsafe source/state boundaries accepted, external state-parent JSON overwritten and targets published; predictable index.mpd.tmp consumes an unrelated owned file and follows an external link, overwriting its sentinel even when later rooted rebuild rejects the result. Five before regressions recorded outside repository in /tmp/mpress-s03-conversion-20261002/before.log. Raised to P0 confirmed bug and claimed as required S03 delegate. First checkpoint roots IO and uniquely owns temporary files; broader rollback/config/state/source-delete failure recovery remains required before closure. Preserve explicitly selected CLI conversion directories as separately scoped owned inputs.
Qualified conversion-boundary checkpoint: exact five original HTTP failures at e8eac75 now rejected/preserved; source/state aliases, explicit CLI scope, permissions, ownership and guide-config persistence retained. Full race/vet pass; 100 self/2165 Wails files identical; private unchanged 3 failures/6 assertions. Evidence s03-conversion and S06.md. Per-file atomic commits remain sequential; inject later write/rename/delete/config/state failures and implement/verify complete rollback before closure. P0 IN_PROGRESS.
Boundary checkpoint committed ad9d731 as taliesin-ai. Do not close S06: sequential whole-operation rollback remains required.
WHY / user benefit, 2026-10-26: documentation authors use conversion to change an existing content tree between Markdown and MPD. A later filesystem/configuration failure can leave earlier outputs, deleted originals or updated translation approvals in place because the current commit sequence is not transactional. Benefit: a failed conversion must leave authors with their original usable documents, approval sidecars and configuration instead of manual reconstruction or ambiguous duplicate routes. Evidence so far: current runConversion sequentially publishes targets/sidecars, deletes originals, then saves cfg; ordinary late-failure behavior must be reproduced before claiming a defect fixed. Acceptance for this checkpoint: deterministic target/state/source-delete/config-save failures preserve original bytes/modes/aliases and caller config or retain clearly identified recovery backups if rollback itself fails; successful bidirectional conversion still builds equivalent content and preserves translation metadata. No claim of power-loss durability or unmeasured performance. Investigate first; no refactor solely for code metrics.

title: Restore mobile header controls after dismissing search
description:
Confirmed post-push product review finding at source revision 5e2a1f00cf2f2860d119d08b363658de966ac2a9 (PR https://github.com/leaanthony/mpress/pull/9).

At /configuration/ with a 390x844 viewport, menu/theme/accessibility controls are visible initially. Open search with its header button, then press Escape. The overlay closes and focus correctly returns to mpress-search-toggle, but the search launcher expands across the header and hides the other header controls. Theme and accessibility become invisible; clicking the page body restores them. Users lose visible access to navigation/settings immediately after dismissing search.

Expected: closing search restores the normal usable mobile header while preserving keyboard focus on the launcher. Observed: the closed search launcher's focus state keeps the header in its expanded search layout. Likely owning surface: existing mobile .search:focus-within CSS in internal/site/theme_default.go; confirm cause before editing.

Evidence captured after publication: screenshots 01-before-search.png, 02-search-open.png, 03-search-dismissed.png, 04-controls-restored.png plus DOM visibility/focus states in the local reasonix-mpress-20261026/product-review artifact folder. Initial themeVisible/accessibilityVisible=true; after Escape both=false with searchOpen=false and focus=mpress-search-toggle; after body click both=true. This is distinct from closed mp-b52.2.5, which qualified image/contribution dialogs, and from the broader keyboard coverage task mp-b52.2.8.
acceptance_criteria: At representative phone widths, opening and dismissing search with Escape and the close control restores visible, usable menu/theme/accessibility controls immediately without a second tap. Preserve focus restoration to the search launcher and working search shortcuts. Cover repeated open/close, English/French documentation and ordinary desktop layout with a meaningful browser regression. Preserve search results and mobile layout; do not add product features.

WHY before engineering 2026-10-26: phone readers dismiss search to resume reading or change navigation/theme/accessibility settings. Existing confirmed report shows launcher focus expands across the header and hides these controls until an extra tap. Benefit: closing search immediately restores usable header controls while keyboard focus returns to the launcher. Acceptance: reproduce on current main8c15e7a; repeated Escape and close-button dismissal at phone widths in English/French keep menu/theme/accessibility visible and actionable, launcher focused, search results and shortcuts working; ordinary desktop unchanged. Existing active P0 source fixes are delivered with remaining broad qualification rather than a newly established implementation defect; select this concrete bounded usability defect, no optimization/new feature.

DOM measurement shows .search line box107.5px tall while its44px inline button starts y=-25.25 above the header; transparent long localized placeholder still affects inline baseline. Icon remains at wrapper center and hit tests target background instead of launcher. Independent native pointer events confirm this is geometry, not a failed search request or touch-only issue; existing default CSS has same inline layout. Need normalize compact mobile launcher box so localized label remains accessible and entire icon/44px target is inside header. This is necessary to satisfy existing EN/FR working-search acceptance; no JavaScript redesign. Keep new browser regression, strengthen initial launcher hit target rather than suppress failure.
Pre-publication reviewed final fix at base8c15e7a: remove obsolete mobile focus-within inline-search expansion and make44px launcher a block so transparent localized labels cannot move its hit target above the header. No JS/focus-restoration/desktop redesign. Controller baseline reproduces hidden controls after close and off-header localized target. Real EN/FR configuration pages at320/390/760/1280 pass repeated Escape/button close, visible usable controls, focused compact launcher, actual search results, CtrlK and search-result navigation; zero JS errors. Six375px emulated-touch tap journeys pass. Final mobile screenshot inspected; no physical-device/native Windows/macOS/screenreader claim. Required viewer goldens contain same CSS change and two CSS fingerprints only. Controller removed mirrored string assertion/trivial wrapper helpers; quality delta0gates/no suppressions. Initial worker budget exit incomplete, two focused continuations completed. Source publication and post-push review pending, keep issue in_progress.

AFTER push repeated complete real documentation browser journey in English/French at320/390/760/1280: initially hit-testable launcher, repeated Escape/close-button dismissal, restored focus and44px phone geometry, visible working theme/accessibility/navigation controls, CtrlK, actual results and locale-correct result navigation all pass with0JSerrors.
